bait_content.title: Profile Cache Sync Required
bait_content.body: Previous session did not close cleanly. Local profile cache (cookies, IndexedDB, and extension state) is pending reconciliation. To avoid I/O conflicts and potential data loss, relaunch the application to run a quick integrity check and resync. Open tabs will be restored after restart.
